responsibilities: As a Business Intelligence Engineer at Amazon, you will connect with world leaders in your field working on similar problems.
You will be working with massive-scale data and providing analytic support to scientists, product managers, engineers using these data.
You will utilize your deep expertise in business analysis, metrics, reporting, and analytic tooling/languages like SQL, Excel, and others, to translate the data into meaningful insights.
You will have ownership of the insights you are building for the business, and will play an integral role in tactical decision-making for critical risk areas.
